description: Partnership for Our Working Coast: Port Fourchon Phase 1 Technical Report is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by publisher not stated on the toolkit page. The Greater Lafourche Port Commission (GLPC) operates Port Fourchon, the nation’s premier oil and gas services port. The Water Institute worked with GLPC to select sites for a beneficial use wetlands creation project based on several criteria, including distance from the channel deepening location and the water depth at the potential placement sites. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Erosion and Shoreline Recession, Flooding – Coastal. Assets: Critical Facilities, Economy, Energy and Utilities, Property, Transportation and Mobility. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
